question: How do I pause SLA timers?
short_answer: Only queues with customer-wait pauses enabled pause timers when state is Waiting on customer.

question: Who can rotate API keys?
short_answer: Only Support Admins can rotate API keys.

question: Can internal notes be exported?
short_answer: Read Only Analysts and above can export permitted reports

question: Why did a conversation reopen?
short_answer: A resolved conversation reopens when the customer replies in the same thread.

question: What happens when a queue is disabled?
short_answer: New inbound inquiries go to the configured fallback queue.
